course.label: Grade
course.help: Each grade keeps its own stars, streak and badges. Only 3rd grade has activities for now.

clearData.label: Delete all my data
clearData.confirmBody: This will permanently delete all your stars, streaks, badges and progress. This action cannot be undone.

account.label: Account
account.help: Sharing this device with another family?
account.switchConfirmBody: You'll be signed out and can sign in with another account. Your child's progress stays safely in the cloud.
